proposed_from.topic: Face-complete endpoint-prior saddles and the answer-open indexability correspondence for asymmetric nonsmooth partial identification: solve the compact non-centrosymmetric polyhedral Gaussian endpoint game over all measurable randomized rules; characterize every saddle, classify the full optimal correspondence into all one-index, coexistence, or no one-index cases, construct convergent primal-dual certificates without a complexity-rate claim, and prove tie-uniform perturbation plus LAN/Le Cam transfer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: a legal 2D witness has value 2/3 and both constant one-index and tanh-perturbed non-one-index optima. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: a non-tautological general indexability criterion. EARLY KILL TEST: interval certification of an unbalanced-prior non-halfspace case.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest results delimit but do not solve this angle. MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Decision proves multiplicity and excludes certain linear thresholds without classifying arbitrary measurable one-index rules. Yata2025Optimal constructs a selected one-index optimum from an antipodal least-favorable pair under centrosymmetry. AradillasFernandezMontielOleaQiuStoyeTinda2026RobustBayes uses the equation-(2.9) constrained prior class and derives ex-ante \(\Gamma\)-MMR and ex-post \(\Gamma\)-PER uniqueness, randomization, and linear-index threshold conclusions; its prior restriction changes Nature's state space, so these conclusions neither imply nor contradict the present unrestricted endpoint-state minimax frontier. The corrected-proof Abstract of ChristensenMoonSchorfheide2026OptimalDecisionRules combines minimax treatment of ambiguity in a partially identified payoff parameter conditional on a point-identified parameter with average-risk minimization for the point-identified parameter. That hybrid asymptotic criterion is orthogonal to the exact unrestricted signed-endpoint minimax-regret criterion, neither criterion implies the other, and the abstract makes no formula-level claim about exclusion of every measurable one-index rule. The new theorem instead starts from a finite asymmetric endpoint prior and proves that exact global saddle closure, analytic noncancellation, and one curved regular score boundary force uniqueness over all measurable randomized rules and rule out every scalar projection \(g(w^{\top}z)\). MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Local confirms that asymmetric directional geometry remains outside its nonsmooth centrosymmetric solution. Teicher1963Mixtures and ZahmEtAl2020Ridge supply, respectively, mixture identifiability and projection-based ridge language, but neither connects those ingredients to an unrestricted minimax treatment correspondence. The carried saddle theorem, face-complete priors, positive-tolerance exchange bounds, and triangular value-\(2/3\) coexistence witness make the certificate globally meaningful. The genuinely open content is an unbalanced rational instance with outward-rounded primal-dual and curvature enclosures, together with a finite necessary-and-sufficient normal-fan trichotomy. Conditional feasible transfer is not counted as the frontier and asserts neither a named-model construction nor a rate.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Section 4; Theorem 3 and its proof; Conclusion, first listed extension
seed_details.kernel: Exact minimax value, attainment, every-saddle characterization, and face-complete endpoint priors for compact asymmetric polyhedral Gaussian games over all measurable randomized rules.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the antipodal two-point lower bound in the proof of Theorem 3 by optimization over signed endpoint priors and the Gaussian-mixture Bayes envelope.
seed_details.destination_search: The target--method search covered unrestricted Gaussian decision rules, least-favorable priors, infinite linear programming, semi-infinite exchange, and finite-menu Hedge; no closer paper was found.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from a generic minimax theorem because the loss is bilinear after Nature randomizes.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic minimax yields equality only after the weak-star compactness and continuity problem is resolved; it does not deliver the explicit Gaussian-mixture Bayes score, all-saddle equalizer conditions, or face-complete representative.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Section 3.3; Theorem 3; Appendix proof Steps 1--5
seed_details.kernel: A necessary-and-sufficient normal-fan and dual-score criterion for whether every optimum is one-index, one-index and non-one-index optima coexist, or no one-index optimum exists.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Upgrade the paper's perturbation of one exhibited efficient-index rule to an annihilator analysis of every binding convolution moment and every least-favorable prior.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for ridge-function Gaussian mixtures, non-halfspace Bayes tests, minimax-rule uniqueness, and full optimal-correspondence factorization found no occupied criterion.
seed_details.red_team: The trichotomy is tautological once the optimal set is defined.
seed_details.rebuttal: The formal contribution requires a finite criterion in primitive face normals, covariance geometry, and dual supports; restating set intersections is explicitly disallowed and retained only as notation.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorems 2 and 4; discussion following each plug-in rule; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Continuity of the value and uniform near-optimality of certified selectors across active-face and indexability ties, followed by a uniform LAN and Le Cam regret transfer.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pointwise matching to a selected optimizer by a primal-dual-gap inequality uniform over the set-valued saddle correspondence.
seed_details.destination_search: Adjacent searches covered directional delta methods, marginal-optimization value maps, set-valued argmin stability, and local asymptotic treatment rules; none treats this saddle correspondence.
seed_details.red_team: Berge's maximum theorem and ordinary LAN transfer make the result routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: Berge gives value continuity and upper hemicontinuity but not a stable exact selector at optimizer ties; the certificate-gap construction is what supplies uniform feasible regret without lower hemicontinuity.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; exact normal-experiment threshold construction; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: An interval-certified two-dimensional unbalanced least-favorable prior yielding a curved unique Bayes boundary and no one-index optimum on a nondegenerate coefficient region.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the monotone likelihood-ratio comparison behind the asymmetric threshold by a signed mixture of at least three Gaussian endpoint densities.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for unbalanced Gaussian-mixture least-favorable tests and non-halfspace minimax treatment rules found no globally certified example.
seed_details.red_team: A curved Bayes boundary is merely a numerical counterexample at one hand-tuned game.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed demands exact primal-dual closure, interval arithmetic, and persistence over a strict coefficient neighborhood; without those it is dropped.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Theorem 1; Remark on infinite decision spaces; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Convergent upper and lower primal-dual certificates for the unrestricted measurable-rule endpoint game, without a complexity-rate claim.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace optimization over a fixed finite rule simplex by exact Bayes minimization against a generated endpoint prior, then exchange in the most violated endpoint state.
seed_details.destination_search: The adjacent exchange-method and infinite-linear-programming literatures cover finite-dimensional primals or finitely constrained tests, not this Gaussian regret game.
seed_details.red_team: This is standard column generation for semi-infinite programming.
seed_details.rebuttal: The primal variable is an arbitrary measurable function; the nonstandard reduction is the weighted Gaussian-mixture Bayes envelope that makes exact restricted solves and global bounds available.

seed_details.anchor_location: Gaussian-limit complete-class argument and local asymptotic minimax theorem
seed_details.kernel: A semiparametric efficiency bound for estimating the optimal Gaussian-game regret value and an attaining one-step estimator away from face and saddle ties.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the dual envelope through the unique least-favorable prior instead of differentiating a fixed smooth welfare functional.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches on efficient influence functions for minimax values and optimal policy values reveal tie-sensitive value inference, but not this endpoint-prior envelope.
seed_details.red_team: Envelope-theorem differentiation makes the efficiency bound immediate whenever the optimizer is unique.
seed_details.rebuttal: The score depends on an infinite-dimensional least-favorable measure and a nonsmooth Gaussian-density minimum; nevertheless the no-tie version is narrower than the main saddle problem.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorems 2 and 4 and their covariance-substitution arguments
seed_details.kernel: Matched minimax rates for estimating the saddle value under a margin exponent controlling mass near endpoint-face and Bayes-score ties.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a local modulus for simultaneous perturbation of endpoint coefficients and least-favorable scores before applying a two-experiment lower bound.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found margin-rate theory for optimal values but no canonical, published margin class for this endpoint saddle map.
seed_details.red_team: The rate would be manufactured by a new margin assumption chosen to force the desired exponent.
seed_details.rebuttal: That objection holds at present because no externally motivated primitive margin class was found; the seed is dropped rather than strengthened ad hoc.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction and discussion of randomized policy recommendations
seed_details.kernel: Invert an exact symmetry or permutation test to report finite-sample sets of regret-optimal policy actions under partial identification.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Gaussian risk comparison by a randomization orbit for the missing welfare contrast.
seed_details.destination_search: No assignment-symmetry structure is supplied by the Gaussian endpoint experiment, and a conformal orbit would require a materially different sampling model.
seed_details.red_team: The anchor contains no exchangeability group capable of identifying the counterfactual regret distribution.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds, so the seed is dropped rather than importing an unrelated experimental design.

seed_details.anchor_location: Section 3.3 profiled-regret comparison; Proposition on linear versus randomized rules; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Characterize when least-randomizing and Bayes-score-selected minimax rules agree, and derive the observable face-contact frontier where their profiled regrets diverge.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the running example's scalar derivative comparison by the normal fan of all binding endpoint faces.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found example-specific profiled-regret dominance but no general polyhedral contact frontier.
seed_details.red_team: The frontier depends on a secondary refinement rather than the minimax criterion itself.
seed_details.rebuttal: The object is relevant but narrower in consumer value than the full correspondence classification, so it is not kept among the top three.

accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The feasible-regret conclusion is asserted only UNDER those explicitly stated approximation and legality premises, and is secondary to the exact Gaussian-game geometry.

banked_reason: The delivered kernel leaves the advertised primitive all/coexistence/none classifier open; conditional curved-score implication is not a realized no-index frontier.
